# Banggai Escape — Engineering Documentation

> Developer and agent index for the Banggai Escape pnpm workspace: a public SvelteKit 2
> marketing site (`apps/web`) and a scaffolded back-office (`apps/admin`), both deployed
> to Cloudflare Workers.

Scope: developer/contributor documentation. Not end-user help. All content is
Markdown in this folder; there is no docs website to crawl.

Canonical entry points:

- [`README.md`](./README.md) — documentation index, reading order, glossary
- [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) — the operational contract for coding agents
- [`../DESIGN.md`](../DESIGN.md) — design system, source of truth for `apps/web`
- [`../README.md`](../README.md) — quick start, scripts, deploy TL;DR
- [`../apps/admin/README.md`](../apps/admin/README.md) — how the admin app was scaffolded

Conventions for agents: docs are numbered for reading order; every file states its
**Scope**, names the paths that implement what it describes, and ends with a
**Related** section. Relative links and heading anchors are verified. Snippets are
illustrative — when a snippet and the source disagree, the source wins.

## Docs

- [01 Getting started](./01-getting-started.md): Prerequisites, install, all root and per-app scripts, the verification loop, editor setup, a first-change tour
- [02 Architecture](./02-architecture.md): Workspace model, both apps' stacks, module boundaries, rendering model, request lifecycle, content-first trade-offs and known gaps
- [03 Project structure](./03-project-structure.md): Annotated file tree for the repo and both apps; where new code goes; generated vs. ignored paths
- [04 Routing and pages](./04-routing-and-pages.md): Full route table, current content slugs, page-by-page anatomy, dynamic-route pattern, SEO habits, routing gaps
- [05 Components](./05-components.md): The 10 shared components in apps/web with props, behaviour, and authoring conventions
- [06 Styling](./06-styling.md): Tailwind v4 setup, the @theme token table, the component/utility class layer, the filter-bar pattern, styling conventions
- [07 Design system](./07-design-system.md): A developer's map of DESIGN.md — where each rule is implemented, the non-negotiables, mobile patterns
- [08 Content data layer](./08-content-data-layer.md): The typed content modules, their exported API and types, recipes for adding packages/destinations/posts/images, invariants
- [09 SEO, metadata and accessibility](./09-seo-and-metadata.md): Document shell, per-page head tags, image conventions, a11y patterns, crawling, roadmap
- [10 Tooling](./10-tooling.md): pnpm workspace, Biome config, svelte-check and tsconfig, skipLibCheck, Vite/SvelteKit config, wrangler types, admin-only tooling
- [11 Deployment](./11-deployment.md): Build output, wrangler.jsonc, build/preview/deploy, environment and secrets, the admin Worker, deploy checklist
- [12 Troubleshooting](./12-troubleshooting.md): The wrangler types trap and 18 more known failure modes with causes and fixes
- [13 Contributing](./13-contributing.md): Workflow, definition of done, Conventional Commits, code style, task checklists, first contributions
- [14 Admin app](./14-admin-app.md): The apps/admin scaffold — stack, better-auth, Drizzle/Neon, shadcn-svelte, scripts, testing, gaps and next steps
- [15 Admin dashboard plan](./15-admin-dashboard-plan.md): Phased product and engineering plan for the CMS, Neon-backed publishing, R2 media, secure administration, and Cloudflare Workers Analytics Engine on the free tier

## Key facts an agent must not get wrong

- Both apps run **SvelteKit 2 stable**; do not upgrade to `next`. `$lib` and inline
  `sveltekit({...})` config both work.
- **`skipLibCheck: true` is required** in every tsconfig — Cloudflare runtime types
  otherwise collide with `lib.dom.d.ts`.
- **Never add `wrangler types --check` back into either app's `check`/`build`**, and
  clear `.svelte-kit/cloudflare` before regenerating types.
- `apps/web` **`bg-white` is Warm Sand `#F7F3ED`**, and `text-white` is Warm Sand too.
- Content lives in `apps/web/src/lib/data/`; pages are presentational.
- Biome owns formatting (tabs, single quotes, 100 columns); run `pnpm fix`.
- The admin package is named `admin`, so its filter is `pnpm --filter admin …`.
- `pnpm check:code` currently fails on the unformatted admin scaffold; gate the site
  with `npx biome check apps/web` until that is cleaned up.
